text: {"lessons":["My account has fluctuated only modestly overall, so I should not mistake short-term changes for a lasting trend or make rushed trades.","I sold some holdings after gains and sold Stock D at a loss, but those outcomes alone do not show whether the decisions were sound; I should base future trades on each holding’s prospects and portfolio risk, not my purchase price.","As a retired investor who depends on these savings, I should protect against large losses, keep a deliberate long-term plan, and avoid unnecessary trading."]}
